title: R3 audit remediation: cockpit integrity gating covers failed/blocked visuals; historical denials/faults never drive current FAILED headline
required_tests: src/__tests__/ui-objective-autonomous-loop.test.ts#no edge animates toward a cockpit node
description: R3 remediation on audited R2 HEAD 28966e6 (correction BASE), vs integration BASE 07f22db. R3-F1: cockpit observation-integrity downgrade now covers EVERY operational visual — proven, active, waiting, failed, blocked — so an unverified cockpit read can no longer paint mission FAILED or drive a FAILED aggregate headline; raw claims remain as explicitly unverified evidence; scheduler/driver/policy failures stay independently authoritative. R3-F2: DENIED/FAULT branch now separates three concepts — (a) last_result.fault on the fence matching the confirmed live claim = current failure (failed, headline-driving); (b) last_result.fault without current-fence correlation = 'latest recorded fault', red but flagged historical ('prior cycle' suffix), excluded from headline badN and active edges; (c) denials alone = 'N past denial(s) · historical' neutral diagnostic, never current FAILED. last_outcome preserved separately; no ordering is inferred from array length or malformed denial metadata. 15 new R3 regressions; two R1-era assertions updated only where they encoded the defective denials=fault / fault-code-strict behavior. 77-scenario vitest total, 7 Playwright specs unchanged-and-green. Root test file remains the documented tooling exception; production scope apps/mission-control-ui/** only; zero backend/authority changes.
